checks: Every shipped source projection exists, hashes correctly, and uses the pinned build when versioned.
Every normalized champion/item scalar stat equals its retained source JSON pointer value.
Every rank-level cooldown/cost/range value equals its explicit source array element; absent entries remain null.
Champion numeric IDs are unique; all roster entries have one top-level Q/W/E/R record.
Unresolved template tokens have null numeric values; no inferred zero substitution.
Item IDs are unique and all recipe parent/quantity relations are valid; missing components are reported, not invented.
Rune IDs are unique and their path/slot relationships exist.
Every CSV parses with UTF-8 BOM and matches its JSON row count.

explicit_limits: No exact server simulation, collision radii, projectile speeds, missile paths, attack windups, animation cancel rules or complete damage formulas are recovered from these files.
QWER contains four top-level spells per champion; transformed forms, recasts, passive variants and runtime overrides are not a complete executable skill graph.
Raw zero arrays remain source zeros, never evidence that an ability deals zero damage. Missing values stay null/blank.
The auxiliary unresolved count excludes only the exact common spellmodifierdescriptionappend token; it is not a verified semantic classification of cosmetic versus gameplay variables.
Item stats are only the structured legacy stats object; tooltip-only passive/active stats and item availability require separate verification.
Modern runesReforged comes from the pinned URL, not the legacy rune=7.23.1 realm entry.
Unversioned constants include historical/deprecated queues and do not prove current server availability.
Structured patch comparison omits ability details and prose-only changes.
